newsitems.title: 50,000 Wishlists: The Investigation Network Grows
newsitems.author: Fatih
newsitems.contents: Hello detectives, Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles has officially reached a massive milestone of 50,000 wishlists on Steam. This dark case, which started with a small clue, has today turned into a grand investigation network of 50,000 detectives. Your unwavering interest in the asymmetric co-op experience and the noir universe we have created is the biggest source of motivation for our team. Thank you endlessly for your support and patience. As you know, the investigation officially begins on October 2nd. Make sure to complete your preparations and find your partner before the files are opened. See you in the shadows, Rock Paper Publisher & Aegean Crafters

newsitems.title: Join our Discord!
newsitems.author: Fatih
newsitems.contents: Hello detectives, The secrets within the universe of Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles are deepening. To solve this dark case and uncover the truths Eva and Miles are tracking, we are gathering all detectives in a single headquarters. Our official Discord server is now live and awaiting your arrival. What awaits you at our investigation headquarters?Find Your Co-op Partner: To fully experience the asymmetric co-op, you can instantly find your missing partner and coordinate your strategies before heading into the mission. Direct Communication with Developers: You can communicate directly with Aegean Crafters, sharing your theories and feedback about the game firsthand. Access to Classified Files: Get early access to behind-the-scenes development footage, new mechanics, and community-exclusive clues before anyone else. To become a part of the investigation network and follow the course of the case with us, you can join our headquarters via the link below. Click Here to Join Our Official Discord Server See you in the shadows, Rock Paper Publisher & Aegean Crafters

newsitems.title: 25,000 Wishlists: The Investigation Reaches an Unexpected Scale
newsitems.author: Fatih
newsitems.contents: Dear detectives, As Aegean Crafters, we are sharing news today that completely changes the scope of the case. Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles has officially reached 25,000 wishlists on Steam. What started as a single clue has now turned into a massive investigative network of 25,000 people. In this asymmetric co-op noir world, the dark secrets Eva and Miles are chasing resonate more than ever. While we work tirelessly in the background to perfect the game's mechanics and puzzles, this intense interest you have shown makes our universe even deeper and more immersive. Keep your preparations going for the big day when the investigation officially begins. Brand new evidence and game details that will change the course of the case will emerge from the shadows very soon. Best regards, Aegean Crafters & Rock Paper Publisher

newsitems.title: Thank You: We Are Now a Detective Team of 10,000!
newsitems.author: Fatih
newsitems.contents: Hello Everyone, As the Aegean Crafters team, we are experiencing a joyous moment where words fall short. Our precious Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles has surpassed the 10,000 wishlists milestone on Steam! In every stage of the development process; while finely crafting the mechanics, designing the puzzles, and building the dark world of Eva and Miles, our biggest dream was for players to want to solve this mystery with us. Today we see that 10,000 detectives are standing side by side with us to bring this dark secret to light. As an indie studio, this massive interest you've shown in our game gives us incredible strength to work day and night. We are working with all our might to present the asymmetric co-op experience to you in its most flawless and exciting form. Thank you all individually for accompanying us on this journey, playing our demo, and supporting us by adding our game to your wishlists. Get ready to delve deeper into the case, we will be sharing many more details with you soon! See you soon, Aegean Crafters
